atoms.1: Corneal abrasions can cause a reflex production of tears.
atoms.2: Corneal abrasions can result in a watery discharge from the eye.
atoms.3: Reflex production of tears is a common symptom of corneal abrasions.
atoms.4: Watery discharge from the eye is a common symptom of corneal abrasions.
atoms.5: A watery discharge from the eye may not always be present in corneal abrasions.
atoms.6: In some cases of corneal abrasions, the discharge may be minimal.
atoms.7: In some cases of corneal abrasions, the discharge may be absent.
atoms.8: Minimal or absent discharge is especially common in the early stages of corneal abrasions.

snippets.output: Corneal abrasions commonly cause reflex tearing and a watery discharge from the eye.
Corneal abrasions do not always cause eye discharge; any discharge may be watery, minimal, or absent, especially in the early stages.
